# /place corpus (flat world, forceloaded area). Success + error cases of feature / jigsaw / structure / template.
#   scripts/command-diff.sh crates/mc-game/tests/fixtures/commands_corpus/place.txt --keep   (then compare the worlds with tools/worldcmp)
# The level random is unseeded in vanilla, so only the messages are compared here for random-driven placements; the
# `template` placements with an explicit seed (and integrity 1.0) are block-deterministic.
gamerule advance_time false
gamerule advance_weather false
forceload add -48 -48 79 79
!wait 3000

# ---- syntax / permission errors
place
place feature
place jigsaw
place structure
place template
place bogus
@bot0 place template minecraft:igloo/top 0 -60 0

place feature {} 2 -60 2
place feature minecraft:desert_well 50 -60 50
